note: The 25 highest six-month scores are shown first; search or show all to see every row. Stronger colour means a higher score; the scale lists each shade's range, and every cell states its exact value.
methodology: Take every tracked event in the last six months (bots excluded), keyed by the repository it occurred in.
Weight each event (issues ×2, reviews ×3, PRs opened ×3, merges ×2) and bucket by month.
Sum the weighted score per repository per month — each event counts once.
Rank repositories by total, show the busiest 25, and colour each cell by its monthly score.
population: A weighted score, not a count: issues ×2, reviews ×3, prs created ×3, prs merged ×2. Other activity (comments, labels) is not scored. Columns are the last 6 complete calendar months (UTC); the current month is excluded. Bots are excluded. Each event counts once, in the repository where it happened.
